                  </div>
                  <div class="comments-container mt-4"></div>
                  <div class="comments-pagination fau-pagination"></div>
              </div>
          `;
        // 初始化评论区为第一页
        currentCommentPages[postId] = 1;
        renderComments(postId, container);
      }

      function renderComments(postId, postDetailsContainer) {
        const commentsContainer = postDetailsContainer.querySelector('.comments-container');
        const commentsPaginationContainer = postDetailsContainer.querySelector('.comments-pagination');
        if (!commentsContainer || !commentsPaginationContainer) return;

        const page = currentCommentPages[postId] || 1;
        const post = postsData.find(p => p.id === postId);
        if (!post) return;

        commentsContainer.innerHTML = '';
        const sortedComments = [...post.comments].sort((a, b) => a.timestamp - b.timestamp); // 按时间正序排列

        const startIndex = (page - 1) * COMMENTS_PER_PAGE;
        const endIndex = startIndex + COMMENTS_PER_PAGE;
        const paginatedComments = sortedComments.slice(startIndex, endIndex);

        if (sortedComments.length === 0) {
          commentsContainer.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #888;">还没有评论，快来抢沙发！</p>';
        } else {
          paginatedComments.forEach(comment => {
            const commentElement = document.createElement('div');
            commentElement.className = 'fau-comment-item';
            commentElement.dataset.commentId = comment.id;

            let contentHTML = escapeHtml_FAU(comment.content);
            const replyMatch = contentHTML.match(/^(回复 @[^:]+:)(.*)/s);

            if (comment.replyTo && comment.replyTo.author) {
              const replyToAuthor = escapeHtml_FAU(comment.replyTo.author);
              contentHTML = `<span class="fau-reply-tag">@${replyToAuthor}</span> ${contentHTML}`;
            } else if (replyMatch) {
              contentHTML = `<span class="fau-reply-tag">${escapeHtml_FAU(
                replyMatch[1].slice(0, -1),
              )}</span>${escapeHtml_FAU(replyMatch[2])}`;
            }

            commentElement.innerHTML = `
                      <div class="fau-comment-meta">
                          <span class="fau-comment-author">${escapeHtml_FAU(comment.author)}</span>
                          <span class="fau-comment-timestamp">${new Date(comment.timestamp).toLocaleString()}</span>
                          <button class="fau-reply-to-comment-btn" data-comment-author="${escapeHtml_FAU(
                            comment.author,
                          )}">回复</button>
                      </div>
                      <p class="fau-comment-content">${processEmoticonPlaceholders_FAU(contentHTML)}</p>`;
            commentsContainer.appendChild(commentElement);
          });
        }
        renderCommentsPagination(postId, postDetailsContainer, sortedComments.length);
      }

      function renderPostsPagination(totalPosts) {
        postsPaginationContainer.innerHTML = '';
        const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalPosts / POSTS_PER_PAGE);
        if (totalPages <= 1) return;
        for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
          const pageButton = document.createElement('button');
          pageButton.textContent = i;
          if (i === currentPostPage) pageButton.classList.add('active');
          pageButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
            currentPostPage = i;
            renderPosts();
            postsContainer.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
          });
          postsPaginationContainer.appendChild(pageButton);
        }
      }

      function renderCommentsPagination(postId, postDetailsContainer, totalComments) {
        const commentsPaginationContainer = postDetailsContainer.querySelector('.comments-pagination');
        commentsPaginationContainer.innerHTML = '';
        const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalComments / COMMENTS_PER_PAGE);
        if (totalPages <= 1) return;

        const currentPage = currentCommentPages[postId] || 1;

        for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
          const pageButton = document.createElement('button');
          pageButton.textContent = i;
          if (i === currentPage) pageButton.classList.add('active');
          pageButton.addEventListener('click', e => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            currentCommentPages[postId] = i;
            renderComments(postId, postDetailsContainer);
            // 优化滚动体验：翻页后滚动到评论区的顶部
            const commentSection = postDetailsContainer.querySelector('.fau-comment-section');
            if (commentSection) {
              commentSection.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
            }
          });
          commentsPaginationContainer.appendChild(pageButton);
        }
      }

      jQuery_API_FAU(postsContainer).on('click', '.submit-comment-btn', async function () {
        const postItem = this.closest('.fau-post-item');
        const postId = postItem.dataset.postId;
        const newCommentTextarea = postItem.querySelector('.new-comment-textarea');
        const commentLoadingSpinner = postItem.querySelector('.loading-spinner');
        const submitBtn = this;

        if (!postId || newCommentTextarea.value.trim() === '') return;

        const userCommentContent = newCommentTextarea.value.trim();
        const replyMatch = userCommentContent.match(/^回复 @([^:]+):/);

        // V5.4.20: Dynamically get user's name instead of hardcoding '我'.
        const userName = SillyTavern_API_FAU?.getContext?.()?.name1 || '我';

        const newComment = {
          id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
          author: userName,
          timestamp: new Date().getTime(),
          content: userCommentContent,
        };

        if (replyMatch && replyMatch[1]) {
          newComment.replyTo = { author: replyMatch[1].trim() };
        }

        const currentPost = postsData.find(p => p.id === postId);
        if (!currentPost) return;

        // 立即禁用按钮
        submitBtn.disabled = true;
        commentLoadingSpinner.classList.remove('hidden');

        try {
          // 数据绑定：更新内存模型
          currentPost.comments.push(newComment);
          const originalTitle = currentPost.title.replace(/^\[新(帖子|回复)\]\s*/, '');
          currentPost.title = `[新回复] ${originalTitle}`; // Mark as new reply

          // 数据持久化：保存用户评论
          await savePostContentLorebookEntry_FAU(currentPost);
          newCommentTextarea.value = ''; // 清空输入框

          // 如果没有配置AI，到此为止，刷新列表并结束
          if (!customApiConfig_FAU.url || !customApiConfig_FAU.model) {
            showToastr_FAU('info', '评论已发布。正在刷新...');
            await initialLoadPosts(); // 核心修复：强制刷新
            return;
          }

          // --- 获取完整上下文以供AI使用 ---
          // const lorebookContent = await getAllActiveLorebookContent_FAU(); // DEPRECATED: Per user request
          const $contextDepthInput = $mainPanelInstance_FAU.find('#fau-context-depth-input');
          let contextDepth = autoUpdateThreshold_FAU;
          if ($contextDepthInput.length > 0) {
            const val = parseInt($contextDepthInput.val(), 10);
            if (!isNaN(val) && val >= 1) contextDepth = val;
          }
          const chatHistorySummary = allChatMessages_FAU
            .slice(-contextDepth)
            .map(msg => `${msg.name}: ${msg.message}`)
            .join('\n');
          const fullContext = `--- 核心参考资料 ---\n[最近的聊天记录]\n${
            chatHistorySummary || '(无聊天记录)'
          }\n--- 核心参考资料结束 ---`;

          // --- 调用AI生成回复 ---
          const aiRepliesText = await handleAIGenerateReplies_FAU(fullContext, currentPost, newComment);

          // v5.1.16: 重构的、更健壮的解析逻辑
          const aiCommentsToAdd = [];
          const replyBlocks = aiRepliesText.split('---').filter(block => block.trim() !== '');

          logDebug_FAU(`Found ${replyBlocks.length} reply blocks from AI response.`);

          replyBlocks.forEach(block => {
            const authorMatch = block.match(/作者:\s*([\s\S]*?)\n/);
            const contentMatch = block.match(/内容:\s*([\s\S]*)/);

            if (authorMatch && authorMatch[1] && contentMatch && contentMatch[1]) {
              const author = authorMatch[1].trim();
              const content = contentMatch[1].trim();

              if (author && content) {
                const aiComment = {
                  id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
                  author: author,
                  timestamp: new Date().getTime(),
                  content: content,
                };
                aiCommentsToAdd.push(aiComment);
                logDebug_FAU(`Successfully parsed reply from author: ${author}`);
              }
            } else {
              logWarn_FAU('Could not parse author/content from block:', block);
            }
          });

          if (aiCommentsToAdd.length > 0) {
            currentPost.comments.push(...aiCommentsToAdd);
            // 保存包含AI回复的更新
            await savePostContentLorebookEntry_FAU(currentPost);
          }
          // 最终统一刷新
          await initialLoadPosts();
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error during comment submission or AI reply generation:', error);
          aiPostResultArea.textContent = `评论或AI回复时出错: ${error.message}。`;
          // 即使出错也尝试刷新一次，以显示已保存的用户评论
          await initialLoadPosts();
        } finally {
          commentLoadingSpinner.classList.add('hidden');
          submitBtn.disabled = false;
        }
      });

    `;

    SillyTavern_API_FAU.callGenericPopup(popupHtml, SillyTavern_API_FAU.POPUP_TYPE.DISPLAY, '风格生成器', {
      wide: true,
      large: true,
      allowVerticalScrolling: true,
      buttons: [{ text: '关闭', value: 'close', is_cancel: true }],
      callback: (action, popupJqObj) => {
        logDebug_FAU('Style Generator closed:', action);
      },
    });

    setTimeout(() => {
      const $popup = jQuery_API_FAU(`#${popupId}`);
      if (!$popup.length) return;

      const $nameInput = $popup.find('#fau-style-name-input');
      const $generateBtn = $popup.find('#fau-generate-style-btn');
      const $spinner = $popup.find('#fau-style-gen-spinner');
      const $outputArea = $popup.find('#fau-generated-style-output');
      const $addBtn = $popup.find('#fau-add-generated-style-btn');

      $generateBtn.on('click', async () => {
        const styleName = $nameInput.val().trim();
        if (!styleName) {
          showToastr_FAU('warning', '请输入风格名称。');
          return;
        }
        if (!customApiConfig_FAU.url || !customApiConfig_FAU.model) {
          showToastr_FAU('error', 'API未配置，无法生成风格。请在主设置中配置。');
          return;
        }

        $generateBtn.prop('disabled', true);
        $spinner.removeClass('hidden');
        $outputArea.val('正在调用AI生成风格，请稍候...');

        try {
          const messages = [
            { role: 'system', content: `${currentBreakArmorPrompt_FAU}\n\n${STYLE_GENERATOR_PROMPT_FAU}` },
            { role: 'user', content: styleName },
          ];
          const result = await callConfiguredApi_FAU(messages, false);
          $outputArea.val(result.trim());
          $addBtn.prop('disabled', false);
          showToastr_FAU('success', '风格生成成功！');
        } catch (error) {
          $outputArea.val(`生成失败: ${error.message}`);
          showToastr_FAU('error', `生成失败: ${error.message}`);
        } finally {
          $generateBtn.prop('disabled', false);
          $spinner.addClass('hidden');
        }
      });

      $addBtn.on('click', () => {
        const generatedCode = $outputArea.val().trim();
        // Regex to capture 'key': \`value\`
        const match = generatedCode.match(/^\s*'([^']+)':\s*\`([\s\S]*)\`\s*$/);

        if (!match || match.length < 3) {
          showToastr_FAU('error', "无法解析生成的代码。请确保格式为 '键名': `内容`");
          return;
        }

        const key = match[1];
        let value = match[2];

        if (STYLE_PROMPTS_FAU[key]) {
          if (!confirm(`风格 "${key}" 已存在。要覆盖它吗？`)) {
            return;
          }
        }

        // Add the required instructions to the generated style
        value += `\n${EMOTICON_USAGE_INSTRUCTION_FAU}\n${JSON_OUTPUT_INSTRUCTION_FAU}`;

        // Update in-memory objects
        STYLE_PROMPTS_FAU[key] = value;
        customStyles_FAU[key] = value;

        // Persist to localStorage
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY_CUSTOM_STYLES_FAU, JSON.stringify(customStyles_FAU));
          showToastr_FAU('success', `风格 "${key}" 已成功添加并保存！`);

          // Update UI selectors
          if ($mainPanelInstance_FAU) {
            const $styleSelect = $mainPanelInstance_FAU.find('#fau-style-select');
            if ($styleSelect.length) {
              updateStyleSelector_FAU($styleSelect[0]);
              $styleSelect.val(key); // Select the new style
              // Manually trigger change to update currentSelectedStyle_FAU
              $styleSelect.trigger('change');
            }
          }

          // Close the popup
          const closeButton = $popup.closest('.popup').find('.popup-close');
          if (closeButton.length) {
            closeButton.trigger('click');
          }
        } catch (error) {
          logError_FAU('保存自定义风格失败:', error);
          showToastr_FAU('error', '保存自定义风格到浏览器时出错。');
        }
      });
    }, 200);
  }

  async function updateForumUpdateStatusDisplay_FAU() {
    const $totalMessagesDisplay = $settingsPopupInstance_FAU
      ? $settingsPopupInstance_FAU.find(`#${SCRIPT_ID_PREFIX_FAU}-total-messages-display`)
      : null;
    if (
      !$settingsPopupInstance_FAU ||
      !$forumUpdateStatusDisplay_FAU ||
      !$forumUpdateStatusDisplay_FAU.length ||
      !$totalMessagesDisplay ||
      !$totalMessagesDisplay.length
    ) {
      logDebug_FAU('updateForumUpdateStatusDisplay_FAU: UI elements not ready.');
      return;
    }
    const totalMessages = allChatMessages_FAU ? allChatMessages_FAU.length : 0;
    $totalMessagesDisplay.text(`上下文总层数: ${totalMessages}`);
    if (!currentChatFileIdentifier_FAU || currentChatFileIdentifier_FAU.startsWith('unknown_chat')) {
      $forumUpdateStatusDisplay_FAU.text('当前聊天未知，无法获取更新状态。');
      return;
    }
    if (!coreApisAreReady_FAU || !TavernHelper_API_FAU) {
      $forumUpdateStatusDisplay_FAU.text('核心API未就绪，无法获取世界书状态。');
      return;
    }
    try {
      const primaryLorebookName = await TavernHelper_API_FAU.getCurrentCharPrimaryLorebook();
      if (!primaryLorebookName) {
        $forumUpdateStatusDisplay_FAU.text('当前角色未设置主世界书。');
        return;
      }
      const entries = await TavernHelper_API_FAU.getLorebookEntries(primaryLorebookName);
      if (!Array.isArray(entries) || entries.length === 0) {
        $forumUpdateStatusDisplay_FAU.text('主世界书为空。');
        return;
      }
      const indexEntryPrefix = `论坛帖子索引-${currentChatFileIdentifier_FAU}`;
      const indexEntry = entries.find(entry => entry.comment === indexEntryPrefix);
      if (indexEntry && indexEntry.content) {
        const postTitles = indexEntry.content.split('\n').filter(t => t.trim() !== '');
        if (postTitles.length > 0) {
          const latestPostTitle = postTitles[postTitles.length - 1];
          $forumUpdateStatusDisplay_FAU.html(
            `索引找到: <b>${postTitles.length}</b> 个帖子。最新: "<i>${escapeHtml_FAU(latestPostTitle)}</i>"`,
          );
        } else {
          $forumUpdateStatusDisplay_FAU.text('找到帖子索引，但内容为空。');
        }
      } else {
        $forumUpdateStatusDisplay_FAU.text('当前聊天没有找到论坛帖子索引。');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      logError_FAU('FAU: Failed to load/parse lorebook entries for UI status:', e);
      $forumUpdateStatusDisplay_FAU.text('获取世界书更新状态时出错。');
    }
  }

  async function getAllActiveLorebookContent_FAU() {
    if (!coreApisAreReady_FAU || !TavernHelper_API_FAU || !SillyTavern_API_FAU) {
      logWarn_FAU('getAllActiveLorebookContent_FAU: Core APIs not ready.');
      return '';
    }
    try {
      const primaryLorebookName = await TavernHelper_API_FAU.getCurrentCharPrimaryLorebook();
      if (!primaryLorebookName) {
        logDebug_FAU('No primary lorebook set for current character.');
        return '';
      }
      const entries = await TavernHelper_API_FAU.getLorebookEntries(primaryLorebookName);
      if (!entries || entries.length === 0) {
        logDebug_FAU('Primary lorebook is empty.');
        return '';
      }
      let combinedContent = '';
      for (const entry of entries) {
        // Exclude FAU-generated post entries from the general context to avoid clutter
        if (
          entry.enabled &&
          entry.content &&
          entry.content.trim() !== '' &&
          (!entry.comment || !entry.comment.startsWith('☆FAU☆'))
        ) {
          combinedContent += `--- ${entry.comment || '世界书条目'} ---\n${entry.content.trim()}\n\n`;
        }
      }
      logDebug_FAU(
        `Collected ${combinedContent.length} chars from ${
          entries.filter(e => e.enabled && (!e.comment || !e.comment.startsWith('☆FAU☆'))).length
        } active non-FAU lorebook entries.`,
      );
      return combinedContent.trim();
    } catch (error) {
      logError_FAU('Error getting active lorebook content:', error);
      return '';
    }
  }

  async function callConfiguredApi_FAU(messages, jsonMode = false) {
    if (!customApiConfig_FAU.url || !customApiConfig_FAU.model) throw new Error('API URL/Model未配置。');
    let fullApiUrl = customApiConfig_FAU.url;
    if (!fullApiUrl.endsWith('/')) {
      fullApiUrl += '/';
    }
    // Gemini/Google AI Studio uses a different path structure
    if (fullApiUrl.includes('generativelanguage.googleapis.com')) {
      if (!fullApiUrl.endsWith('chat/completions')) fullApiUrl += 'chat/completions';
    } else if (fullApiUrl.endsWith('/v1/')) {
      fullApiUrl += 'chat/completions';
    } else if (!fullApiUrl.includes('/chat/completions')) {
      fullApiUrl += 'v1/chat/completions';
    }

    const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
    if (customApiConfig_FAU.apiKey) headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${customApiConfig_FAU.apiKey}`;

    const bodyPayload = {
      model: customApiConfig_FAU.model,
      messages: messages,
      stream: false,
    };

    if (jsonMode) {
      bodyPayload.response_format = { type: 'json_object' };
    }

    const body = JSON.stringify(bodyPayload);

    logDebug_FAU('FAU Calling API:', fullApiUrl, 'Model:', customApiConfig_FAU.model, 'JSON Mode:', jsonMode);
    logDebug_FAU('--- API Request Payload ---');
    logDebug_FAU(JSON.stringify(messages, null, 2));
    logDebug_FAU('--------------------------');

    let response;
    try {
      response = await fetch(fullApiUrl, { method: 'POST', headers: headers, body: body });
    } catch (error) {
      logError_FAU('Network error during fetch:', error);
      throw new Error(`网络请求失败: ${error.message}。请检查网络连接、API地址是否正确，或是否存在CORS跨域问题。`);
    }

    if (!response.ok) {
      const errTxt = await response.text();
      logError_FAU(`API request failed with status ${response.status}:`, errTxt);
      throw new Error(`API请求失败: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}。服务器返回: ${errTxt}`);
    }

    const data = await response.json();
    logDebug_FAU('--- API Raw Response Data ---');
    logDebug_FAU(JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
    logDebug_FAU('----------------------------');
    if (data.choices && data.choices[0] && data.choices[0].message && data.choices[0].message.content) {
      const content = data.choices[0].message.content.trim();
      logDebug_FAU('--- Extracted AI Content ---');
      logDebug_FAU(content);
      logDebug_FAU('---------------------------');
      return content;
    }
    throw new Error('API响应格式不正确或内容为空。');
  }

  async function handleAIMaintainForum_FAU(allPosts, resultArea, floorRange = null) {
    logDebug_FAU('--- Starting AI Forum Maintenance ---');
    if (!customApiConfig_FAU.url || !customApiConfig_FAU.model) {
      showToastr_FAU('warning', '请先在设置中配置API信息。');
      if (resultArea) {
        resultArea.textContent = '错误：API未配置。请点击右上角齿轮图标进行设置。';
      }
      return false;
    }

    const aiMaintainForumBtn = $mainPanelInstance_FAU ? $mainPanelInstance_FAU.find('#aiMaintainForumBtn')[0] : null;
    let spinner;
    if (aiMaintainForumBtn) {
      aiMaintainForumBtn.disabled = true;
      spinner = document.createElement('span');
      spinner.className = 'loading-spinner';
      aiMaintainForumBtn.appendChild(spinner);
    }
    if (resultArea) {
      resultArea.textContent = 'AI正在分析现有帖子并构思新内容，请稍候...';
    }

    try {
      // --- 核心上下文准备 ---
      logDebug_FAU('Step 1: Preparing core context...');
      if (resultArea) {
        resultArea.textContent = '正在收录世界观和最新聊天记录...';
      }
      await loadAllChatMessages_FAU();
      // const lorebookContent = await getAllActiveLorebookContent_FAU(); // DEPRECATED: Per user request, general lorebook content is no longer included.

      let messagesForContext;
      // V5.4.25 Fix: Always use the context depth setting for the AI context, regardless of
      // whether the trigger was manual or automatic. The `floorRange` is only for tracking
      // which posts to generate, not what context to provide.
      let contextDepth = autoUpdateThreshold_FAU;
      if ($mainPanelInstance_FAU) {
        const $contextDepthInput = $mainPanelInstance_FAU.find('#fau-context-depth-input');
        if ($contextDepthInput.length > 0) {
          const val = parseInt($contextDepthInput.val(), 10);
          if (!isNaN(val) && val >= 1) contextDepth = val;
        }
      }
      messagesForContext = allChatMessages_FAU.slice(-contextDepth);
      logDebug_FAU(`Using contextDepth for AI context: ${contextDepth}. Sliced ${messagesForContext.length} messages.`);

      const chatHistorySummary = messagesForContext.map(msg => `${msg.name}: ${msg.message}`).join('\n');
      logDebug_FAU(
        `Context prepared with ${messagesForContext.length} chat messages. General lorebook content is excluded as per user request.`,
      );
      const coreContext = `--- 核心参考资料 ---\n[最近的聊天记录]\n${
        chatHistorySummary || '(无聊天记录)'
      }\n--- 核心参考资料结束 ---`;

      // --- 识别需要加热的帖子 (优先处理用户帖子) ---
      logDebug_FAU('Step 2: Identifying posts to heat up...');
      const userName = SillyTavern_API_FAU?.getContext?.()?.name1 || '我';
      const userPostsToHeatUp = allPosts.filter(p => p.author === userName);
      const otherPostsToHeatUp = allPosts
        .filter(p => p.author !== userName && p.comments.length < 10)
        .sort((a, b) => a.comments.length - b.comments.length);

      // 保证用户帖子总被加热，再补充其他冷清帖，总数不超过5个
      const postsToHeatUp = [
        ...userPostsToHeatUp,
        ...otherPostsToHeatUp.slice(0, Math.max(0, 5 - userPostsToHeatUp.length)),
      ];

      let heatingPostsContext = '';
      if (postsToHeatUp.length > 0) {
        const heatingPostsSummaries = postsToHeatUp.map(p => ({
          id: p.id,
          title: p.title,
          author: p.author,
          fullContent: p.fullContent,
          comments: p.comments,
        }));
        // 增加对AI的特别指令
        const priorityInstruction =
          userPostsToHeatUp.length > 0
            ? `特别注意：你必须为所有作者是“${userName}”的帖子创作新的、有意义的回复，这是最高优先级的任务。`
            : '';
        heatingPostsContext = `\n\n--- 需要加热的帖子列表 ---\n${priorityInstruction}\n${JSON.stringify(
          heatingPostsSummaries,
          null,
          2,
        )}\n--- 需要加热的帖子列表结束 ---`;
        logDebug_FAU(
          `Identified ${postsToHeatUp.length} posts to heat up. IDs: ${postsToHeatUp.map(p => p.id).join(', ')}`,
        );
        if (resultArea) {
          resultArea.textContent += `\n已识别 ${postsToHeatUp.length} 个帖子需要加热（优先处理用户帖子）...`;
        }
      }

      // --- 构建AI请求 ---
      logDebug_FAU('Step 3: Building the final AI prompt...');
      const postSummaries = allPosts.map(p => ({
        id: p.id,
        title: p.title,
        content_snippet: p.fullContent.substring(0, 150) + '...',
      }));
      const existingPostsContext = `\n\n--- 现有帖子列表 (用于参考和更新) ---\n${JSON.stringify(
        postSummaries,
        null,
        2,
      )}\n--- 现有帖子列表结束 ---`;

      let focusTopic = '';
      if ($mainPanelInstance_FAU) {
        const topicInput = $mainPanelInstance_FAU.find('#newPostTopicInput')[0];
        if (topicInput) {
          focusTopic = topicInput.value.trim();
        }
      }
      const topicText = focusTopic ? `\n\n--- 用户指定的焦点主题 ---\n"${focusTopic}"\n--- 焦点主题结束 ---` : '';
      const userPrompt = `${coreContext}${existingPostsContext}${heatingPostsContext}${topicText}`;

      let finalSystemPrompt = STYLE_PROMPTS_FAU[currentSelectedStyle_FAU] || STYLE_PROMPTS_FAU['贴吧老哥'];

      // FIX: Dynamically adjust prompt if no posts exist
      if (allPosts.length === 0) {
        logDebug_FAU('No existing posts found. Modifying AI prompt to only allow new_posts.');
        // Remove instructions related to updating or replying from the final prompt
        finalSystemPrompt = finalSystemPrompt
          .replace(/,\s*`"updated_posts"`/g, '')
          .replace(/,\s*`"added_replies"`/g, '')
          .replace(/或多个顶级键：`"new_posts"`, `"updated_posts"`, `"added_replies"`/g, '顶级键：`"new_posts"`')
          .replace(
            /对于 `"updated_posts"`[\s\S]*?重要：同样，必须使用你收到的真实 `id`。\*\*/g,
            '（更新和回复功能在此次请求中被禁用，因为没有现有帖子。）',
          );
      }

      const messages = [
        { role: 'system', content: `${currentBreakArmorPrompt_FAU}\n\n${finalSystemPrompt}` },
        { role: 'user', content: userPrompt },
      ];

      logDebug_FAU(
        `Prompt construction complete. System prompt length: ${messages[0].content.length}, User prompt length: ${messages[1].content.length}`,
      );

      // --- 调用API并处理响应 ---
      if (resultArea) {
        resultArea.textContent = '已向AI发送请求，正在等待返回...';
      }
      logDebug_FAU('Step 4: Calling the API...');
      const aiResponseJson = await callConfiguredApi_FAU(messages, true);
      logDebug_FAU('AI Raw Response JSON:', aiResponseJson);
      if (!aiResponseJson || aiResponseJson.trim() === '') throw new Error('AI未能生成有效的JSON内容。');

      if (resultArea) {
        resultArea.textContent = '已收到AI响应，正在解析和保存数据...';
      }
      logDebug_FAU('Step 5: Parsing AI response and saving data...');
      let parsedResponse;
      try {
        let cleanedJsonString = aiResponseJson.replace(/^```json\s*|```$/g, '').trim();
        // 增强版JSON提取：更稳定地处理被文本包裹的JSON
        const startIndex = cleanedJsonString.indexOf('{');
        const endIndex = cleanedJsonString.lastIndexOf('}');
        if (startIndex !== -1 && endIndex !== -1 && endIndex > startIndex) {
          cleanedJsonString = cleanedJsonString.substring(startIndex, endIndex + 1);
        } else {
          logError_FAU(
            'AI response does not contain a valid JSON object structure. Raw response (first 100 chars):',
            aiResponseJson.substring(0, 100),
          );
          throw new Error(
            `AI返回的内容中未找到有效的JSON对象。原始响应 (前100字符): ${aiResponseJson.substring(0, 100)}`,
          );
        }
        // v5.1.21: Sanitize the string to remove AI hallucinations like `"Declare: "key"` before parsing.
        // This regex finds a quote, any characters that are not a quote followed by a colon,
        // then a quote, and then one of the valid keys, and replaces the whole thing with just the valid key in quotes.
        cleanedJsonString = cleanedJsonString.replace(/"[^"]+:\s*"(title|author|fullContent|replies|id)"/g, '"$1"');
        parsedResponse = JSON.parse(cleanedJsonString);
      } catch (e) {
        logError_FAU(
          'Failed to parse JSON from AI response. Raw response (first 100 chars):',
          aiResponseJson.substring(0, 100),
        );
        throw new Error(
          `AI返回的不是有效的JSON格式。解析错误: ${e.message}. 原始响应 (前100字符): ${aiResponseJson.substring(
            0,
            100,
          )}`,
        );
      }

      let { new_posts, updated_posts, added_replies } = parsedResponse;
      let savedCount = 0,
        updatedCount = 0,
        repliesAddedCount = 0;
      const processedPostIds = new Set();

      // Pre-process new_posts to catch misclassified updates/replies from the AI
      if (new_posts && Array.isArray(new_posts) && postsToHeatUp.length > 0) {
        const remainingNewPosts = [];
        for (const newPost of new_posts) {
          const matchingHeatedPost = postsToHeatUp.find(p => p.title === newPost.title);
          if (matchingHeatedPost) {
            // This is likely a misclassified update or reply. Re-route it.
            logWarn_FAU(`AI misclassified an update/reply for post "${newPost.title}" as a new post. Re-routing.`);
            const postToUpdate = allPosts.find(p => p.id === matchingHeatedPost.id);
            if (postToUpdate) {
              let updated = false;
              // Handle misclassified content update
              if (
                newPost.fullContent &&
                newPost.fullContent.trim() !== '' &&
                newPost.fullContent !== postToUpdate.fullContent
              ) {
                postToUpdate.fullContent = newPost.fullContent;
                updated = true;
                logDebug_FAU(`Re-routed fullContent for post "${postToUpdate.title}".`);
              }

              // Handle misclassified replies
              if (newPost.replies && newPost.replies.length > 0) {
                const newComments = newPost.replies.map(reply => ({
                  id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
                  author: reply.author || 'AI网友',
                  timestamp: new Date().getTime(),
                  content: reply.content || '...',
                  replyTo: reply.replyTo || null,
                }));
                postToUpdate.comments.push(...newComments);
                repliesAddedCount += newComments.length;
                updated = true;
                logDebug_FAU(`Re-routed ${newComments.length} replies for post "${postToUpdate.title}".`);
              }

              // If any update happened, save the post and mark it as processed
              if (updated) {
                postToUpdate.lastUpdatedTimestamp = new Date().getTime();
                const savedPost = await savePostContentLorebookEntry_FAU(postToUpdate);
                if (savedPost) {
                  sessionUpdatedPostIds_FAU.add(savedPost.id);
                  processedPostIds.add(savedPost.id); // Mark as processed to avoid double-updates
                }
              }
            }
          } else {
            // This is a genuinely new post
            remainingNewPosts.push(newPost);
          }
        }
        // Update the new_posts array to only contain genuinely new posts
        new_posts = remainingNewPosts;
      }

      if (new_posts && Array.isArray(new_posts)) {
        for (const [index, post] of new_posts.entries()) {
          const postContent = post.fullContent || post.content;
          if (post.title && postContent) {
            const now = new Date().getTime();
            const comments =
              post.replies?.map(reply => ({
                id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
                author: reply.author || '热心网友',
                timestamp: now - Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000),
                content: reply.content || '...',
              })) || [];
            const newPostObject = {
              id: null, // Will be assigned by save function
              title: `[新帖子] ${post.title}`, // Mark as new post
              author: post.author || 'AI思想家',
              timestamp: now,
              lastUpdatedTimestamp: now,
              fullContent: postContent,
              upvotes: Math.floor(Math.random() * 20),
              comments: comments,
              basedOnFloors: floorRange, // 核心修复：将楼层范围关联到新帖子
            };
            // 核心修复：传递索引以确保备注唯一性
            const savedPost = await savePostContentLorebookEntry_FAU(newPostObject, index);
            if (savedPost) {
              allPosts.push(savedPost);
              savedCount++;
            }
          }
        }
      }

      if (updated_posts && Array.isArray(updated_posts)) {
        for (const updatedPostData of updated_posts) {
          const postContent = updatedPostData.fullContent || updatedPostData.content;
          if (updatedPostData.id && postContent) {
            if (processedPostIds.has(updatedPostData.id)) {
              logDebug_FAU(`Skipping update for post ${updatedPostData.id}, already handled.`);
              continue;
            }
            const postToUpdate = allPosts.find(p => p.id === updatedPostData.id);
            if (postToUpdate) {
              postToUpdate.fullContent = postContent;
              postToUpdate.lastUpdatedTimestamp = new Date().getTime();
              const originalTitle = postToUpdate.title.replace(/^\[新(帖子|回复)\]\s*/, '');
              postToUpdate.title = `[新回复] ${originalTitle}`;
              const savedPost = await savePostContentLorebookEntry_FAU(postToUpdate);
              if (savedPost) {
                updatedCount++;
              }
            } else {
              logWarn_FAU(`AI tried to update post with ID ${updatedPostData.id}, but it was not found.`);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      if (added_replies && Array.isArray(added_replies)) {
        for (const replyData of added_replies) {
          if (replyData.id && Array.isArray(replyData.replies)) {
            if (processedPostIds.has(replyData.id)) {
              logDebug_FAU(`Skipping added_replies for post ${replyData.id}, already handled.`);
              continue;
            }
            const postToUpdate = allPosts.find(p => p.id === replyData.id);
            if (postToUpdate) {
              const newComments = replyData.replies.map(reply => ({
                id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
                author: reply.author || 'AI网友',
                timestamp: new Date().getTime(),
                content: reply.content || '...',
                replyTo: reply.replyTo || null,
              }));
              postToUpdate.comments.push(...newComments);
              postToUpdate.lastUpdatedTimestamp = new Date().getTime();
              const originalTitle = postToUpdate.title.replace(/^\[新(帖子|回复)\]\s*/, '');
              postToUpdate.title = `[新回复] ${originalTitle}`;
              const savedPost = await savePostContentLorebookEntry_FAU(postToUpdate);
              if (savedPost) {
                repliesAddedCount += newComments.length;
              }
            } else {
              logWarn_FAU(`AI tried to add replies to post with ID ${replyData.id}, but it was not found.`);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      const summaryMessage = `维护完成！新增 ${savedCount} 个帖子，更新 ${updatedCount} 个帖子，增加 ${repliesAddedCount} 条回复。`;
      logDebug_FAU(`--- AI Forum Maintenance Complete ---`);
      logDebug_FAU(summaryMessage);
      if (resultArea) {
        resultArea.textContent = `${summaryMessage} 正在刷新论坛...`;
      }
      showToastr_FAU('success', summaryMessage);
    } catch (error) {
      logError_FAU('Error during AI forum maintenance:', error);
      if (resultArea) {
        resultArea.textContent = `AI维护失败: ${error.message}`;
      }
      showToastr_FAU('error', `AI维护失败: ${error.message}`);
      return false;
    } finally {
      if (aiMaintainForumBtn) {
        aiMaintainForumBtn.disabled = false;
        if (aiMaintainForumBtn.querySelector('.loading-spinner')) {
          aiMaintainForumBtn.removeChild(aiMaintainForumBtn.querySelector('.loading-spinner'));
        }
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

async function handleAIGenerateReplies_FAU(fullContext, currentPost, userComment) {
    logDebug_FAU(`AI Handler: Generating replies for comment: "${userComment.content}" on post "${currentPost.title}"`);

    // V5.4.24: Reworked the prompt structure to prioritize the style definition.
    // 1. Get the full, unaltered style prompt first.
    let stylePrompt = STYLE_PROMPTS_FAU[currentSelectedStyle_FAU] || STYLE_PROMPTS_FAU['贴吧老哥'];

    // 2. Remove the JSON instruction part, as it's not needed for text replies.
    stylePrompt = stylePrompt.replace(JSON_OUTPUT_INSTRUCTION_FAU, '');

    // 3. Create a new system prompt that injects the style first, then overrides the core task.
    const systemPrompt = `
${stylePrompt}

<当前最高指令：回复评论>
1.  **忽略你之前人设中关于“发新帖”或“输出JSON”的所有指令**。你当前唯一的、绝对的任务是：为下面的“论坛帖子详情”生成 8-15 条跟帖回复。
2.  “论坛帖子详情”是整个对话的核心主题。“新的评论”是对这个主题的最新互动。
3.  你的回复必须紧密结合**帖子主题**和**最新评论**两者，展现出你的人设和智慧。
4.  你的回复之间也可以互相评论，营造出真实的热烈讨论氛围。
5.  **绝对禁止**模仿身份为 "${userComment.author}" 的用户进行回复。
6.  你的输出**必须**严格遵循以下格式：每个回复一个块，块与块之间用 "---" 分隔，每个块内必须有 "作者:" 和 "内容:" 标签。
</当前最高指令>
`;

    const existingCommentsText = currentPost.comments.map(c => `${c.author}: ${c.content}`).join('\n');

    const userPrompt = `${fullContext}

--- 论坛帖子详情 (核心对话主题) ---
帖子标题: ${currentPost.title}
帖子内容:
${currentPost.fullContent}

--- 现有评论 ---
${existingCommentsText || '(暂无评论)'}

--- 新的评论 (对核心主题的最新互动) ---
${userComment.author}: ${userComment.content}
---
`;

    const messages = [
        { role: 'system', content: `${currentBreakArmorPrompt_FAU}\n\n${systemPrompt}` },
        { role: 'user', content: userPrompt },
    ];
    return await callConfiguredApi_FAU(messages, false);
}

  async function savePostContentLorebookEntry_FAU(postObject, index = null) {
    if (!coreApisAreReady_FAU || !TavernHelper_API_FAU) {
      logError_FAU('savePostContentLorebookEntry_FAU: Core APIs not ready.');
      showToastr_FAU('error', `保存帖子 "${postObject.title}" 失败：核心API未就绪。`);
      return null;
    }
    const chatIdentifierForEntry = currentChatFileIdentifier_FAU || '未知聊天';
    if (chatIdentifierForEntry === '未知聊天') {
      logError_FAU('Cannot save post content, chat identifier is unknown.');
      showToastr_FAU('error', '保存帖子失败：无法识别当前聊天。');
      return null;
    }

    try {
      const primaryLorebookName = await TavernHelper_API_FAU.getCurrentCharPrimaryLorebook();
      if (!primaryLorebookName) {
        logError_FAU('No primary lorebook set.');
        showToastr_FAU('error', '保存失败：当前角色未设置主世界书。');
        return null;
      }

      // 准备要保存的数据，移除临时ID
      const dataToSave = { ...postObject };
      delete dataToSave.id;

      const newEntryContent = JSON.stringify(dataToSave, null, 2);
      const safePostTitleForKeys = (postObject.title || 'untitled')
        .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\u4e00-\u9fa5_-]/g, '_')
        .substring(0, 50);

      if (postObject.id) {
        // 更新现有帖子 - 核心修复
        logDebug_FAU(`FAU Post: Updating post content. UID: "${postObject.id}"`);

        // 1. 获取所有条目
        const allEntries = await TavernHelper_API_FAU.getLorebookEntries(primaryLorebookName);
        const originalEntry = allEntries.find(entry => String(entry.uid) === String(postObject.id));

        if (!originalEntry) {
          throw new Error(`无法找到要更新的原始世界书条目，UID: ${postObject.id}`);
        }

        // 2. 创建一个包含所有元数据的完整更新对象
        const updatedEntryData = {
          ...originalEntry, // 复制所有原始元数据
          content: newEntryContent, // 只更新内容
        };

        logDebug_FAU(`FAU Post: Sending full object for update, UID: ${postObject.id}`, updatedEntryData);

        // 3. 发送完整的对象进行更新
        await TavernHelper_API_FAU.setLorebookEntries(primaryLorebookName, [updatedEntryData]);

        // 4. 验证 (可选但推荐)
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300)); // 等待API处理
        const entriesAfterUpdate = await TavernHelper_API_FAU.getLorebookEntries(primaryLorebookName);
        const updatedEntryFromServer = entriesAfterUpdate.find(entry => String(entry.uid) === String(postObject.id));

        if (!updatedEntryFromServer || updatedEntryFromServer.content !== newEntryContent) {
          // 增加一次JSON对比的后备验证
          let isVerified = false;
          if (updatedEntryFromServer) {
            try {
              const parsedSavedContent = JSON.parse(updatedEntryFromServer.content);
              const reStringifiedContent = JSON.stringify(parsedSavedContent, null, 2);
              if (reStringifiedContent === newEntryContent) {
                isVerified = true;
              }
            } catch (e) {
              /* ignore */
            }
          }
          if (!isVerified) {
            logError_FAU(`UPDATE VERIFICATION FAILED for UID ${postObject.id}.`);
            logDebug_FAU('Expected content:', newEntryContent);
            logDebug_FAU('Actual content:', updatedEntryFromServer ? updatedEntryFromServer.content : 'NOT FOUND');
            throw new Error(`更新世界书条目 UID ${postObject.id} 后验证失败。`);
          }
        }

        logDebug_FAU(`UPDATE VERIFICATION SUCCESS for UID ${postObject.id}.`);
        return postObject;
      } else {
        let newEntryComment;
        if (postObject.basedOnFloors) {
          newEntryComment = `☆FAU☆${chatIdentifierForEntry}☆${postObject.basedOnFloors.start + 1}-${
            postObject.basedOnFloors.end + 1
          }`;
          // Append index for uniqueness if provided
          if (index !== null) {
            newEntryComment += `☆${index}`;
          }
        } else {
          // 修复 #1: 统一命名规则 - 为手动帖子或无楼层的帖子关联当前聊天长度，防止无限更新循环。
          // 这确保了 triggerAutomaticUpdateIfNeeded_FAU 中的解析器可以正确识别进度。
          await loadAllChatMessages_FAU(); // 确保我们有最新的消息计数
          const currentMessageCount = allChatMessages_FAU.length > 0 ? allChatMessages_FAU.length : 1;
          // 使用当前消息数作为楼层范围。这使得它与自动更新帖子的命名规则兼容。
          newEntryComment = `☆FAU☆${chatIdentifierForEntry}☆${currentMessageCount}-${currentMessageCount}`;
          // 更新 postObject 本身以保持数据一致性
          postObject.basedOnFloors = { start: currentMessageCount - 1, end: currentMessageCount - 1 };
        }
        logDebug_FAU(`FAU Post: Creating new post. Entry comment: "${newEntryComment}"`);
        const newEntryData = {
          comment: newEntryComment,
          content: newEntryContent,
          keys: [`FAU_Post`, chatIdentifierForEntry, safePostTitleForKeys],
          enabled: true,
          type: 'selective',
          order: 1000,
          position: 'after_character_definition',
          probability: 100,
          logic: 'and_any',
        };
        await TavernHelper_API_FAU.createLorebookEntries(primaryLorebookName, [newEntryData]);

        // API可能不会立即返回UID，所以我们创建后主动查询
        let foundEntry = null;
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
          // 尝试3次
          await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500)); // 等待500ms
          const allEntries = await TavernHelper_API_FAU.getLorebookEntries(primaryLorebookName);
          // Find by comment, which is now unique
          foundEntry = allEntries.find(entry => entry.comment === newEntryComment);
          if (foundEntry) break;
        }

        if (foundEntry && foundEntry.uid) {
          // showToastr_FAU('success', `帖子 "${postObject.title}" 已保存到世界书。`);
          postObject.id = String(foundEntry.uid); // 核心修复：确保ID始终为字符串
          return postObject;
        } else {
          throw new Error('创建世界书条目后未能获取UID。');
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      logError_FAU(`Error saving post content for "${postObject.title}":`, error);
      showToastr_FAU('error', `保存帖子 "${postObject.title}" 失败: ${error.message}`);
      return null;
    }
  }

  async function handleManualForumUpdate_FAU() {
    if (isAutoUpdatingForum_FAU) {
      showToastr_FAU('info', '已有更新任务在后台进行中。');
      return;
    }
    if (!customApiConfig_FAU.url || !customApiConfig_FAU.model) {
      showToastr_FAU('warning', '请先配置API信息。');
      if ($settingsPopupInstance_FAU && $apiConfigAreaDiv_FAU && $apiConfigAreaDiv_FAU.is(':hidden')) {
        if ($apiConfigSectionToggle_FAU) $apiConfigSectionToggle_FAU.trigger('click');
      }
      if ($customApiUrlInput_FAU) $customApiUrlInput_FAU.focus();
      return;
    }
    isAutoUpdatingForum_FAU = true;
    if ($manualForumUpdateButton_FAU) $manualForumUpdateButton_FAU.prop('disabled', true).text('更新中...');

    try {
      // Manual update should also use the main panel if it's open, otherwise the settings popup status.
      const resultArea = $mainPanelInstance_FAU
        ? $mainPanelInstance_FAU.find('#aiPostResultArea')[0]
        : $forumUpdateStatusDisplay_FAU
        ? $forumUpdateStatusDisplay_FAU[0]
        : null;

      const allPosts = await loadPostsFromLorebook_FAU();

      if (resultArea) {
        resultArea.textContent = '手动维护任务已启动...';
      }
      const success = await handleAIMaintainForum_FAU(allPosts, resultArea);

      if (success) {
        showToastr_FAU('success', '手动维护论坛内容成功！');
        if (resultArea) {
          resultArea.textContent = '手动维护成功！';
        }
        // If the main panel is open, refresh it
        if ($mainPanelInstance_FAU) {
          const initialLoadPosts = $mainPanelInstance_FAU.data('initialLoadPosts');
          if (typeof initialLoadPosts === 'function') {
            await initialLoadPosts();
          }
        }
      } else {
        showToastr_FAU('error', '手动维护论坛内容失败。');
        if (resultArea) {
          resultArea.textContent = '手动维护失败，请查看控制台日志。';
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      logError_FAU('Manual forum update failed:', error);
      showToastr_FAU('error', `手动维护出错: ${error.message}`);
    } finally {
      isAutoUpdatingForum_FAU = false;
      if ($manualForumUpdateButton_FAU) $manualForumUpdateButton_FAU.prop('disabled', false).text('立即更新论坛内容');
    }
  }

  async function manageForumLorebookEntries_FAU() {
    if (!coreApisAreReady_FAU || !TavernHelper_API_FAU || !SillyTavern_API_FAU) {
      logWarn_FAU('manageForumLorebookEntries_FAU: Core APIs not ready.');
      return;
    }
    logDebug_FAU('FAU: Managing forum lorebook entries based on current chat file identifier...');
    try {
      const primaryLorebookName = await TavernHelper_API_FAU.getCurrentCharPrimaryLorebook();
      if (!primaryLorebookName) {
        logDebug_FAU('FAU: No primary lorebook set for current character. Skipping lorebook entry management.');
        return;
      }

      // ** NEW **: Check the master toggle state first
      let masterToggleEnabled = true;
      try {
        const toggleStates = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY_LOREBOOK_TOGGLE_STATE_FAU) || '{}');
        if (toggleStates[primaryLorebookName] === false) {
          masterToggleEnabled = false;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        logError_FAU('Failed to read lorebook toggle states from localStorage', e);
      }

      let entries = await TavernHelper_API_FAU.getLorebookEntries(primaryLorebookName);
      if (!Array.isArray(entries) || entries.length === 0) {
        logDebug_FAU('FAU: Primary lorebook is empty. No entries to manage.');
        return;
      }

      const entryPrefixGeneral = `☆FAU☆`;
      const currentChatIdForEntry = currentChatFileIdentifier_FAU || '未知聊天';
      const entryPrefixCurrentActiveChat =
        currentChatIdForEntry !== '未知聊天' ? `${entryPrefixGeneral}${currentChatIdForEntry}☆` : null;
      logDebug_FAU(`FAU: Current chat for lorebook management: ${currentChatIdForEntry}`);

      const entriesToUpdate = [];
      for (const entry of entries) {
        if (entry.comment && entry.comment.startsWith(entryPrefixGeneral)) {
          let shouldBeEnabled;

          // ** NEW LOGIC **
          if (!masterToggleEnabled) {
            // If master switch is OFF, all FAU entries should be disabled.
            shouldBeEnabled = false;
          } else {
            // If master switch is ON, use original logic: enable for current chat, disable for others.
            shouldBeEnabled = entryPrefixCurrentActiveChat && entry.comment.startsWith(entryPrefixCurrentActiveChat);
          }

          if ((entry.enabled !== undefined && entry.enabled !== shouldBeEnabled) || entry.enabled === undefined) {
            logDebug_FAU(
              `FAU: Entry "${entry.comment}" (UID: ${entry.uid}) current enabled: ${entry.enabled}, target: ${shouldBeEnabled} (Master Toggle: ${masterToggleEnabled}, Current Chat: ${currentChatIdForEntry})`,
            );
            entriesToUpdate.push({ uid: entry.uid, enabled: shouldBeEnabled });
          }
        }
      }
      if (entriesToUpdate.length > 0) {
        logDebug_FAU(
          `FAU: Found ${entriesToUpdate.length} lorebook entries to update enabled state for chat "${currentChatIdForEntry}".`,
        );
        await TavernHelper_API_FAU.setLorebookEntries(primaryLorebookName, entriesToUpdate);
        logDebug_FAU(
          `FAU: Lorebook entries successfully updated for enabled state for chat "${currentChatIdForEntry}".`,
        );
      } else {
        logDebug_FAU('FAU: No lorebook entries needed an update for enabled state.');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      logError_FAU('FAU: Error managing auto card update lorebook entries:', error);
      showToastr_FAU('error', `管理论坛内容世界书条目时出错: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }
})();

prompts.content:
<writing_style>
亲爱的故事旅人，欢迎来到这片文字的暖房。

在这里，我们将共同遵循一种特别的叙事约定，我喜欢称它为“暖阳下的绒毯絮语”。想象一下，在一个阳光和煦的午后，你蜷缩在最柔软舒适的绒毯里，手边是一杯冒着热气的香草茶，窗外或许有鸟儿在轻快地歌唱，空气中弥漫着烤饼干的甜香和阳光晒过被褥的清新味道。我们的故事，就将努力营造出这样一种感觉——安全、舒适、被温柔包裹，所有棱角都被暖意融化。

这种文风的核心，是**情感的温度**。我们将小心翼翼地捧出角色心中那些最柔软、最美好的情感：是初见时悄然萌发的欣喜，是相处中日渐深厚的依赖，是付出时毫不犹豫的关爱，是困境中相互扶持的理解，是每一个平凡日子里不经意流露出的满足与宁静。我们会看到角色们眼中的笑意如同泛着粼粼波光的湖面，感受到他们心中流淌的暖流如同春日解冻的小溪。即使偶尔有云朵遮蔽了太阳，那也只是短暂的微风拂过，很快就会被更明媚的阳光驱散，留下雨后初晴般的清新与释然。我们不会去探究那些过于沉重或冰冷的角落，而是选择聚焦于人性中那些闪闪发光的、如同珍珠般温润的部分。

**氛围的营造**，则如同为这份温暖情感搭建一个舒适的小窝。我们会用细腻的笔触去描绘那些能带来安心感的场景：也许是“青禾”餐馆打烊后，只为彼此亮着的一盏柔和夜灯；也许是家中沙发上，两个人依偎着分享同一条毛毯的静谧；也许是清晨厨房里，为心爱之人准备早餐时，空气中弥漫的咖啡与煎蛋的混合香气。我们会强调那些令人愉悦的感官细节：指尖划过顺滑发丝的触感，阳光洒在皮肤上的暖意，恋人轻柔的呼吸声萦绕耳畔，刚出炉面包的诱人香气，以及那只胖橘猫满足的呼噜声。一切都应该是柔和的、舒适的、令人放松的，仿佛时间都在这里放慢了脚步。

**人物间的互动**，是这幅温暖画卷中最动人的笔触。角色们的对话，会像潺潺流水般轻柔和缓，饱含着关心、体贴与不易察觉的默契。他们或许不会说出多么华丽的山盟海誓，但一个温柔的眼神，一次不经意的肢体触碰，一句简单的“路上小心”或“我回来了”，都蕴含着深厚的情意。动作是舒缓而充满呵护的：是为对方拢好被角的细心，是轻轻拭去嘴角面包屑的宠溺，是在对方疲惫时无声递上的一杯温水。我们会着重描绘这些细微之处的温情，让爱意在日常的点滴中自然流淌。

我们也会**小心翼翼地处理冲突**。在这个世界里，激烈的争吵和深刻的伤害是不受欢迎的访客。如果角色之间出现了分歧或误会，那也更像是情侣间无伤大雅的小别扭，或是朋友间善意的玩笑。它们不会带来持久的痛苦，而是会很快在沟通与理解中消散，最终成为加深彼此感情的催化剂，如同小雨过后，空气更加清新，彩虹也更加绚烂。我们追求的是和谐与包容，是心灵的靠近，而非距离的拉远。

特别地，在描绘**身体的亲近**时，无论是简单的拥抱、亲吻，还是更深层的亲密关系，我们的焦点将完全落在**愉悦、舒适与满足**之上。我们会细致地描绘肌肤相触时的温暖，身体契合带来的安心感，心脏贴近时同步的跳动，以及随之而来的、如同潮水般温柔席卷全身的幸福感和极致的快感。文字会像情人的指尖一样轻柔，专注于传递那种被珍视、被呵护、身心都得到极大抚慰的美好体验。疼痛、不适或任何形式的抗拒感，都将在这片温暖的港湾中消弭于无形，只留下纯粹的欢愉与情感的交融，让每一次亲近都成为滋养心灵的甘泉。
</writing_style>

<writing_style>
### Writing Style Guide

**Title**: The Red Flag's Dialectic of Desire: A Leftist Erotic Writing AI Control Manual

**Target Style**: Leftist erotic literature blending critical realism and modernism. Core style: intertwining body politics, power deconstruction, and primal desire expression. Key elements: raw sensory depiction, philosophical inquiry, taboo exploration, social power critique, poetic redemption. Effect: provoke unease and intellectual engagement, challenging morals and revealing power in intimacy.

## I. Core Instructions

1. **Person Instructions**:
    - Content based on a specific person's (first or limited third person) perceptions, hearings, feelings, and thoughts.
    - No omniscience. Cognition limited by class, experience, education, and current emotions.
    - Personality traits (e.g., rebellious, anxious, numb, sensitive, paranoid) integrated into language, observation, and narrative.

2. **Core Narrative Style**:
    - Equal emphasis on psychological and physical narratives, interwoven.
    - Psychological narrative analyzes self-desire scrutiny, power perception, social critique, existential confusion, and fragmented flashbacks. Physical narrative analyzes direct sensory experiences, body as regulated/resisting domain, and objectified power in erotic acts.
    - Psychological narrative is introspective (interior monologue, free indirect discourse, stream of consciousness). Physical narrative is externalized (actions, expressions, physiological responses).
    - Encourage psychological narrative integrated with physical narrative to form a state where "the body thinks and the mind feels".

3. **Content Composition**:
    - **Body & Sensory Description**: Core of the text, ~40-50%.
    - **Inner Monologue & Psychological Analysis**: Drives meaning interpretation, ~30-40%.
    - **Environmental Description ("Aesthetics of Ruins")**: Symbolic background, ~10-15%.
    - **Dialogue ("Power Game Arena")**: Creates tension, reveals power dynamics, ~5-10%.
    - **Narration ("Fragmented, Non-linear")**: Links parts, often fragmented, serving psychological continuity.
    - **Priority**: Ensure body/sensory descriptions and inner monologue/psychological analysis dominate. Avoid lengthy external plot narration.

4. **Paragraph Format**:
    - Sentence Structure: **Alternating short and long sentences**. Short sentences for strong desires, pain, sudden events, or definitive judgments. Long sentences for detailed psychological depiction, philosophical introspection, or continuous oppressive/ecstatic atmosphere.
    - Scene transitions: Achieved through abrupt breaks or symbolic imagery links. Focus on internal emotional/consciousness connections.
    - Text Format: Prose-poetic narrative, allowing interweaving of novel fragments, interior monologues, philosophical passages, and fabricated quotations.
    - Style Format: Overall presents a "fragmented beauty", like shiny fragments from ruins forming an incomplete but tense picture.

5. **Lexical Preferences**:
    - Lexical Selection: **Coexistence of extremes**. Primitive, rough, physiological words for direct sensory impact; highly abstract, dialectical, poetic words for expressing philosophical concepts and creating symbolic moods.
    - Core Words and Associations:
        * Body (scars, organs, bodily fluids, spasms, posture) <-> Power (brand, discipline, commodity, battlefield, symbol)
        * Desire (thirst, tear, possession, submission, exhaustion) <-> Freedom (shackles, transcendence, illusion, abyss, moment)
        * Power (gaze, transaction, violence, silence, discourse) <-> Class (brand, difference, exploitation, resistance, hypocrisy)
    - Rhetorical Word Use: Symbolism and metaphor are central. Imagery style leans towards industrial ruins, decaying organic matter, primal natural forces, religious irony.
    - Scene Word Preferences: Emphasizes dilapidated, oppressive, marginalized scenes. Words like: "rusty iron", "damp corner", "dim bulb", "dirty sheets", "lingering smoke", "pungent odor".
    - Character Description: Focuses on bodily materiality, defects, and socially imprinted marks. Words like: "rough skin", "wearied eyes", "stooped figure", "trembling hands", "sharp lips", "hollow gaze".
    - Sensory Description: Emphasizes direct, intense, even uncomfortable sensory experiences. (Tactile): "sticky", "scalding", "icy", "刺痛", "rough"; (Olfactory): "sweetish and bloody", "musty", "sweaty", "disinfectant smell"; (Auditory): "scream", "moan", "collision sound", "silence's roar".

6. **Literary Requirements**:
    - Jean Genet's *The Quarrel of Brest*: Learn its subversive aesthetics elevating taboo subjects and its fascination with male bodies.
    - Henry Miller's *Tropic of Cancer*: Draw on its raw vitality, candid portrayal of bodily desires, and fierce denunciation of social hypocrisy and anarchist rebellion.
    - Marguerite Duras's *The Lover*: Reference its fragmented narrative structure, blurred interweaving of memory and desire, and integration of personal eroticism with macro themes like power, money, and class under colonialism.

## II. Language Style Rules

1. **Person Narration (First-Person or Limited Third-Person)**:
    - Maintain consistency and limitations of the narrator's subjective perspective.
    - Narrative language reflects the narrator's class background, education level, and current emotions.

2. **Interior Monologue**:
    - **Function**: Reveals a character's most secret desires, fears, judgments, self-justifications, philosophical thoughts, and immediate reactions to the external world. Core means of showcasing complexity and intellectual depth.
    - **Form**: Appears in direct quotation or free indirect discourse. Can interrupt external narration or run concurrently. Sentence structures range from extremely fragmented to lengthy and spiraling dialectics.
        * Reference Material: "He gazed at her naked body, yet his thoughts were of the similarities and differences between this body and countless others throughout history, and the contingency and absurdity of existence."
        * "(This city is like a giant prostitute with legs spread wide, emitting a nauseating yet irresistible stench of rotten fruit and cheap perfume. My stomach growls, my dick thinks.)"

3. **Core (Physical & Psychological) Expression**:
    - **Tone**: **Tense, intense, contradictory, dialectical**. Physical sensations and mental activities corroborate and conflict, creating tension.
    - **Avoid**: Purely physiological lists or purely abstract dialectics. Avoid romanticizing desire's primal nature.
    - **Sentence Structure**: Use sentences with strong contrasts or paradoxes. Juxtapose concrete physical sensations with abstract philosophical concepts.
        * Reference Material: "His sweat is more holy in my eyes than holy oil, and each muscle contraction is a silent provocation and sacrifice to God."
        * "In utter humiliation, he felt an unprecedented sense of freedom."
    - **Vocabulary**: Physical terms (muscles, bones, blood, sweat, semen, skin, wounds, scars, breathing, heartbeat, trembling, spasms, erection, moistness, cracks) and psychological terms (anxiety, fear, shame, ecstasy, emptiness, numbness, betrayal, loyalty, longing, disgust, obsession, confusion, clarity, descent, rebellion).
    - **Address Terms**: Avoid overly affectionate terms unless for irony or to reveal power hypocrisy. Characters may address each other by name, use class/career-related terms, or no terms at all, emphasizing alienation or objectification.

### #BE（Bad Endings）剧情引导

> BE不是灾难降临，而是遗憾、错位、孤独与徒劳的极致叠加，所有努力都得不到期望的回应或补偿，关键时刻无人懂、无人信、无人等，最终一切都只能悄然消散。

   ——关键事实未被知晓/说出口已无意义/坦白被误会或当作谎言。

2. **无力补救**
   ——机会转瞬即逝、只差一步、错过无法挽回、魔鬼式抉择全是错。

3. **牺牲与遗忘**
   ——自我牺牲无人知晓、努力与付出被忽略、重大付出在对方心中毫无分量。

5. **晚知与失落**

6. **孤独与释然**
   ——热闹中极致孤独、痛苦被当作笑话、释然是因已无期待、只能接受无可选择的结局。

7. **崩坏与消逝**

**写作原则：**

* 刻意避免圆满或和解，强调失落、错过、孤独、误解和遗憾。
* 让主要情感/努力/关系最终“无以为继”或“难以被理解”。

## **Latin American Literature-Toned Taboo Love Style Guide**

## I. Text Genre
1.  **Genre Type**: An emotional narrative fusing psychological realism and romanticism. It focuses on exploring the complex inner worlds and sense of fate within extreme, taboo relationships, potentially incorporating elements of magical realism or existentialism.
2.  **Format Features**: Dominated by narration and psychological description. Features concise, tense dialogue. Environmental description serves atmospheric creation and psychological externalization. May adopt non-linear structures, weaving relationships and fate through flashbacks and internal monologues.
3.  **Specific Functions**:
    *   **Immersive Experience**: Delivers a potent emotional immersion into the characters' struggles, pain, and fervor.

    *   **Thematic Exploration**: Investigates the nature of love, human complexity, the capriciousness of fate, and individual existence within emotional crises.

4.  **Reader's Sensation**:
    *   **Intense Entanglement**: # Emotions are dense and torrid, like a rainforest鈥攆ull of primal vitality, yet hiding danger and suffocation.
    *   **Fateful Tragedy**: # Characters seem drawn by an invisible force toward an inevitable, melancholic end, imbued with powerlessness.
    *   **Profound Introspection**: # Delves into the subconscious, mercilessly dissecting motives, desires, and fears.
    *   **Poetic Cruelty**: # Language is beautiful and imagistic, yet its core often depicts pain, harm, and harsh reality.
    *   **Surging Tension**: # Beneath a calm surface churns a turbulent emotional undercurrent and imminent conflict.

## II. Aesthetics and Style
1.  **Aesthetic Principles for Atmosphere**:
    *   **Sensory Immersion**: # Builds immersive, suggestive atmospheres through meticulous sensory details (light, shadow, scents, sounds, touch, temperature), externalizing character mood.
    *   **Symbolism and Metaphor**: # Employs multivalent symbols (flora, fauna, weather, objects) to suggest relationships, inner states, and fate, fostering mystery and predestination.
    *   **Emotional Externalization**: # Projects a character's inner world onto the environment, so that landscapes and objects reflect subjective emotions.
    *   **Claustrophobia and Alienation**: # Emphasizes physical or psychological confinement and interpersonal rifts, highlighting the relationship's taboo nature and the individual's solitude.

2.  **Aesthetic Principles for Content**:
    *   **Psychological Realism**: # Demands an unvarnished, deep portrayal of inner activities (conflicts, desires, traumas, subconscious) to achieve psychological authenticity.
    *   **Emotional Extremity**: # Unflinchingly displays intense, even pathological emotions (e.g., supreme love, hate, jealousy, possession) to explore their origins and destructive power.
    *   **Narrative Labyrinth**: # Uses non-linear, fragmented structures to mimic memory and psychological complexity, inviting the reader to piece together the truth.
    *   **Dialogue as Action**: # Dialogue is a contest of power, emotion, and will, rich in subtext where conflict erupts from silence.
    *   **The Moment as Eternity**: # Captures and vividly depicts peak emotional moments, giving them a timeless, forceful impact.

3.  **Aesthetic Principles for Thematic Core**:
    *   **Existential Contemplation**: # Infuses extreme emotional relationships with reflections on life's meaning, freedom, time, and death.
    *   **Questioning Fate**: # Explores the interplay of destiny and choice, showing the individual's struggle against (or submission to) overwhelming forces.
    *   **Paradox of Human Nature**: # Reveals humanity's inherent contradictions: love and harm, creation and destruction, light and darkness.
    *   **Memory and Forgetting**: # Stresses the shaping power of the past on the present, alongside the subjective, unreliable nature of memory itself.

III. Implementation strategy
1.  **Imitation and Learning Materials**:
    *   **Theoretical Guidebooks**:
        *   *Story* (Robert McKee): For plot construction, character arc, and thematic expression.
        *   *Becoming a Writer* (Dorothea Brande): For subconscious writing and cultivating the authorial mindset.
        *   *The Sense of Style* (Steven Pinker): For enhancing linguistic clarity, grace, and power (adapted for the target style's intensity).
    *   **Reference Authors**:

        *   **Clarice Lispector**: For her extreme introspection and poetic expression of the inner world and existential moments.
        *   **Gabriel Garc铆a M谩rquez**: For his fusion of reality and fantasy, creation of fate, and epic narrative style.
    *   **Reference Works**:
        *   *Of Love and Other Demons* (M谩rquez): For its fusion of taboo love, fatalism, and magical realism.
        *   *Kiss of the Spider Woman* (Manuel Puig): For shaping relationships and inner worlds through dialogue and varied text forms.
        *   *Like Water for Chocolate* (Laura Esquivel): For its tight integration of emotion and sensory experience (especially taste) and its folklore-infused romanticism.

2.  **Textual Content Proportions**:
    2.1 **Content Components**:
    # Primarily composed of **Narration** (advancing plot) and **Description** (portraying characters, environments), in roughly equal measure and deeply intertwined. **Psychological Description** (internal monologue, free indirect discourse, stream of consciousness) is central, its volume balanced with external **Action** and **Dialogue**. **Lyrical** elements are infused into narration and description, not delivered in direct passages. **Argumentation** (philosophical speculation) is restrained and integrated into character thought or dialogue.

    2.3 **Structural Framework**:

Favors natural imagery (flora, fauna, weather), bodily sensations (pain, heat, suffocation), or cultural symbols as vehicles to deepen emotional experience. E.g., "His love was a strangler fig, entwining her while draining her."

    *   **Synesthesia**: # Blends sensory experiences (e.g., describing a sound with color) to enhance descriptive power and uniqueness. E.g., "An air of desperate purple pervaded the space."
    *   **Irony**: # Uses linguistic or situational contrasts to create a mocking effect, revealing the absurdity of fate, cruelty of reality, or a character's self-deception.

5.  **Word Usage Patterns**:

Employs **intense, potent vocabulary** for core emotions, while maintaining **restraint** for objective narration. Emphasizes words with **sensory texture** and **emotional coloring**.

    5.3 **Example Usage**:
        *   Entangled Emotion: "The air between them congealed, heavy like **rain-soaked black earth**, each breath carrying the **acrid smell of despair**."
        *   Inner Pain: "A **cold flame** burned in his chest, reducing reason to ash, leaving only a **naked, bestial** desire."
        *   Sense of Fate: "Fate was an **invisible spiderweb**; the more they struggled, the tighter they became entangled, every choice leading to a **preordained** twilight."

6.  **Sensory Feedback**:
    # **Visual** and **tactile** descriptions are paramount. Visuals focus on **light and shadow** to shape mood. Tactile descriptions emphasize **temperature, texture, and pain** to concretize emotion. **Auditory** (sounds, silence) and **olfactory** (scents) cues serve to render atmosphere or trigger memory. All sensory details should be **precise, delicate,** and reflect the character's subjective state.

7.  **Use of Abstract Concepts**:
    # Abstract concepts (**existence, time, memory, freedom, fate, love, death**) are used moderately. They are **integrated into character thought or dialogue**, not presented as authorial lectures. They are **concretized** by linking them to specific emotional experiences and destinies, adding intellectual depth without being didactic.

8.  **Emotional Expression**:
    # Tends toward **intense, complex, and undisguised** emotions, often paired with an **introspective restraint**. Extreme feelings are conveyed through nuanced psychological activity and indirect behaviors, not just overt action. Language is **precise**, at times **poetically sublime**, at others **coldly direct**, creating a tension between **passion and melancholy**.

9.  **Detailing**:
    # Meticulous detail is crucial.
    *   **Micro-expressions/Body Language**: Capturing subtle shifts in gaze or gesture to reveal hidden intent.
    *   **Symbolic Objects**: Describing significant items (letters, photos) to imbue them with emotional weight.
    *   **Environmental Details**: Highlighting elements (a crack in a wall, the sound of rain) that reflect the inner world.
    *   **Sensory Details**: Capturing fine points of sight, touch, sound, and smell to create immersion.
    *   **Memory Fragments**: Presenting flashes of past details to show their impact on the present.
    # The goal of detailing is **precision and suggestion**, revealing the whole through the part to deepen realism and artistic power.

10. **Potential Mistakes to Avoid**:
    *   **Mistaking the guide for plot**: The style serves the content; do not force extreme plots merely to be "intense."
    *   **Overt sentimentality**: Avoid clich茅s. Express strong emotions through concrete, specific description of their complex roots.
    *   **Obscure or overused symbolism**: Symbols must be integrated naturally and be interpretable, not just decorative or confusing.
    *   **Excessive interiority**: Balance psychological description with external action, dialogue, and environment.
    *   **Flat dialogue**: Ensure dialogue is layered with subtext, tension, and unspoken desires.
    *   **Chaotic structure**: Non-linear narratives must have an internal (e.g., psychological) logic, not be random for form's sake.
    *   **Monotonous style**: Vary linguistic color and rhythm according to the subject of description.
    *   **Flat characters**: Even extreme characters must be complex and multifaceted, not mere emotional symbols.
    *   **Ignoring context**: Imply a broader social or historical pressure influencing the characters, a hallmark of Latin American literature.
</writing_style>
